<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>TraceGuard AI - From failure alert to merged fix, automatically</title>
  <meta name="description" content="TraceGuard AI is the remediation layer for LLM agent failures. Alert in, merged patch PR out. Works with LangSmith, Langfuse, or any monitoring tool." />

  <!-- Favicon -->
  <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="favicon.svg" />

  <!-- Open Graph -->
  <meta property="og:title" content="TraceGuard AI - From failure alert to merged fix, automatically" />
  <meta property="og:description" content="The remediation layer for LLM agent failures. Works with LangSmith, Langfuse, or any monitoring tool. Alert in, merged patch PR out." />
  <meta property="og:type" content="website" />
  <meta property="og:url" content="https://saurabh-oss.github.io/traceguard-ai/" />
  <meta property="og:image" content="https://saurabh-oss.github.io/traceguard-ai/og.svg" />
  <meta property="og:image:width" content="1200" />
  <meta property="og:image:height" content="630" />
  <meta property="og:image:alt" content="TraceGuard AI - The remediation layer for LLM agent failures" />

  <!-- Twitter / X Card -->
  <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
  <meta name="twitter:title" content="TraceGuard AI - From failure alert to merged fix, automatically" />
  <meta name="twitter:description" content="The remediation layer for LLM agent failures. Works with LangSmith, Langfuse, or any tool. Alert in, merged patch PR out." />
  <meta name="twitter:image" content="https://saurabh-oss.github.io/traceguard-ai/og.svg" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --bg:       #020817;
      --bg2:      #0d1526;
      --bg3:      #111827;
      --border:   rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
      --border2:  rgba(20,184,166,0.25);
      --teal:     #14b8a6;
      --teal-dim: #0d9488;
      --sky:      #38bdf8;
      --text:     #f1f5f9;
      --muted:    #94a3b8;
      --faint:    #475569;
      --red:      #f87171;
      --orange:   #fb923c;
      --yellow:   #fbbf24;
      --green:    #4ade80;
      --purple:   #a78bfa;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* ── NAV ── */
    nav {
      position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 2rem; height: 60px;
      background: rgba(2,8,23,0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .nav-logo {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem;
      font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--text);
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    .nav-logo .dot { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; background: var(--teal); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--teal); }
    .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 1.8rem; align-items: center; }
    .nav-links a { color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight:500; transition: color .2s; }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--text); }
    .nav-links a.nav-btn,
    .nav-btn {
      background: var(--teal); color: #020817 !important; padding: 0.4rem 1.1rem;
      border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700;
      text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s;
    }
    .nav-links a.nav-btn:hover,
    .nav-btn:hover { background: #2dd4bf; color: #020817 !important; }

    /* ── SECTIONS ── */
    section { padding: 5rem 1.5rem; }
    .container { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .section-label {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      background: rgba(20,184,166,0.1); border: 1px solid var(--border2);
      color: var(--teal); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 999px; margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
    }
    .section-title { font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.6rem); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .section-sub { color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.05rem; max-width: 680px; }

    /* ── HERO ── */
    #hero {
      min-height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center; align-items: center; text-align: center;
      padding: 7rem 1.5rem 5rem;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% -10%, rgba(20,184,166,0.12) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 80% 80%, rgba(56,189,248,0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
        var(--bg);
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-grid {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0.04;
      background-image: linear-gradient(var(--border) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 60px 60px;
    }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      background: rgba(20,184,166,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(20,184,166,0.3);
      color: var(--teal); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600;
      padding: 0.4rem 1rem; border-radius: 999px; margin-bottom: 2rem;
      position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    .hero-badge .pulse { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--teal); animation: pulse 2s infinite; }
    @keyframes pulse { 0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)} 50%{opacity:.6;transform:scale(1.3)} }
    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 6vw, 4.5rem); font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    .hero-title .grad {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal) 0%, var(--sky) 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }
    .hero-sub {
      color: var(--muted); font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.2rem);
      max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto 2.5rem; position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    .hero-buttons { display: flex; gap: 1rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; position: relative; z-index:1; margin-bottom: 3.5rem; }
    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--teal); color: #020817; padding: 0.75rem 1.8rem;
      border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem;
      text-decoration: none; transition: all .2s; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .btn-primary:hover { background: #2dd4bf; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(20,184,166,0.3); }
    .btn-ghost {
      background: transparent; color: var(--text); padding: 0.75rem 1.8rem;
      border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem;
      text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid var(--border); transition: all .2s;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }
    .hero-stats { display: flex; gap: 2.5rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; position:relative;z-index:1; }
    .hero-stat { text-align: center; }
    .hero-stat .num { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--teal); line-height: 1; }
    .hero-stat .lbl { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 0.25rem; }

    /* ── PROBLEM ── */
    #problem { background: var(--bg2); }
    .problem-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 1.5rem; margin-top: 3rem; }
    @media (max-width: 640px) { .problem-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .problem-card {
      background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.8rem; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .problem-card::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--red) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }
    .problem-icon { font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .problem-card h3 { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
    .problem-card p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.6; }

    /* ── SOLUTION ── */
    #solution { background: var(--bg); }
    .quote-box {
      background: rgba(20,184,166,0.06); border: 1px solid var(--border2);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--teal); border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0;
      padding: 1.5rem 2rem; margin: 2.5rem 0; font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-style: italic; color: var(--text);
    }
    .quote-box span { color: var(--teal); font-style: normal; font-weight: 600; }
    .solution-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 3rem; align-items: center; margin-top: 1rem; }
    @media (max-width: 700px) { .solution-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .solution-steps { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.2rem; }
    .step-item { display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: flex-start; }
    .step-num {
      width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(20,184,166,0.15);
      border: 1px solid var(--border2); color: var(--teal); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px;
    }
    .step-item h4 { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.2rem; }
    .step-item p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }

    /* ── ARCHITECTURE ── */
    #architecture { background: var(--bg2); }
    .arch-diagram {
      margin: 3rem auto 0; max-width: 960px;
      background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 2.5rem; overflow-x: auto;
    }
    .arch-svg { display: block; margin: 0 auto; width: 100%; height: auto; min-width: 700px; }

    /* ── PIPELINE STEPS ── */
    #pipeline { background: var(--bg); }
    .pipeline-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem; margin-top: 3rem; }
    .pipeline-card {
      background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.8rem; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
      transition: border-color .2s, transform .2s;
    }
    .pipeline-card:hover { border-color: var(--border2); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .pipeline-card::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--teal) 0%, var(--sky) 100%);
    }
    .pipeline-num {
      font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 900; color: rgba(20,184,166,0.5);
      line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 1rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
    .pipeline-card h3 { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    .pipeline-card p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.65; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .tag-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem; }
    .tag {
      background: rgba(20,184,166,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(20,184,166,0.2);
      color: var(--teal); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 4px;
    }
    .tag.sky { background: rgba(56,189,248,0.08); border-color: rgba(56,189,248,0.2); color: var(--sky); }
    .tag.purple { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.08); border-color: rgba(167,139,250,0.2); color: var(--purple); }

    /* ── TAXONOMY ── */
    #taxonomy { background: var(--bg2); }
    .taxonomy-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin-top: 3rem; }
    .taxonomy-card {
      background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px; padding: 1.2rem 1.4rem;
      transition: border-color .2s;
    }
    .taxonomy-card:hover { border-color: var(--border2); }
    .tax-name {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--teal); margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }
    .taxonomy-card p { font-size: 0.84rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.5; }

    /* ── CAPABILITIES ── */
    #capabilities { background: var(--bg); }
    .cap-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem; margin-top: 3rem; }
    .cap-card {
      background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.6rem; display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: flex-start;
      transition: border-color .2s;
    }
    .cap-card:hover { border-color: var(--border2); }
    .cap-icon {
      width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 10px;
      background: rgba(20,184,166,0.1); border: 1px solid var(--border2);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 1.3rem; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .cap-card h3 { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; }
    .cap-card p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.86rem; line-height: 1.6; }

    /* ── SCREENSHOTS ── */
    #screenshots { background: var(--bg2); }
    .tabs { display: flex; gap: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; width: fit-content; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
    .tab {
      padding: 0.6rem 1.4rem; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;
      background: transparent; color: var(--muted); border: none; transition: all .15s;
    }
    .tab.active { background: var(--teal); color: #020817; }
    .tab:hover:not(.active) { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: var(--text); }
    .screen-panel { display: none; }
    .screen-panel.active { display: block; }

    /* Browser mockup */
    .browser {
      background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .browser-bar {
      background: #1a2234; padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .dots { display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; }
    .dot-red   { width:11px; height:11px; border-radius:50%; background:#ef4444; }
    .dot-yel   { width:11px; height:11px; border-radius:50%; background:#f59e0b; }
    .dot-grn   { width:11px; height:11px; border-radius:50%; background:#22c55e; }
    .url-bar {
      flex: 1; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.25rem 0.8rem; font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--muted); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    }
    .browser-body { padding: 0; }

    /* dashboard mockup */
    .mock-nav {
      background: #0d1526; padding: 0.7rem 1.2rem;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .mock-nav-logo { color: var(--teal); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; }
    .mock-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 1.2rem; }
    .mock-nav-link { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.78rem; }
    .mock-nav-link.active { color: var(--teal); }
    .mock-feed { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--teal); font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; background:rgba(20,184,166,0.06); border:1px solid var(--border2); padding:0.2rem 0.6rem; border-radius:4px; }
    .mock-body { padding: 1.2rem; }
    .mock-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 0.8rem; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; }
    .mock-stat-card { background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.8rem; }
    .mock-stat-card .s-val { font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text); }
    .mock-stat-card .s-lbl { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 0.1rem; }
    .mock-stat-card.crit .s-val { color: var(--red); }
    .mock-stat-card.high .s-val { color: var(--orange); }
    .sim-btns { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .sim-btn {
      background: rgba(20,184,166,0.08); border: 1px solid var(--border2);
      color: var(--teal); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600;
      padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 5px; cursor: default;
    }
    .mock-cards { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.8rem; }
    .mock-card { background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem; }
    .mock-card-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    .sev { font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; letter-spacing:.05em; }
    .sev.critical { background:rgba(239,68,68,.15); color:var(--red); border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.25); }
    .sev.high     { background:rgba(251,146,60,.15); color:var(--orange); border:1px solid rgba(251,146,60,.25); }
    .sev.medium   { background:rgba(251,191,36,.15); color:var(--yellow); border:1px solid rgba(251,191,36,.25); }
    .sev.low      { background:rgba(74,222,128,.15); color:var(--green); border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.25); }
    .mock-card-title { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; flex: 1; }
    .mock-status { font-size: 0.65rem; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; }
    .mock-status.patched { color: var(--green); }
    .mock-status.classified { color: var(--yellow); }
    .mock-card-root { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.5; }
    .mock-evidence {
      margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.7rem; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem; border-radius: 5px;
      color: var(--red); border-left: 2px solid var(--red);
    }
    .mock-pr-row { margin-top: 0.6rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
    .pr-badge {
      font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px;
      background: rgba(74,222,128,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(74,222,128,0.25); color: var(--green);
    }
    .pr-link { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--sky); font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; }

    /* patch review mockup */
    .mock-patch-card { background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.8rem; overflow: hidden; }
    .mock-patch-header { padding: 0.9rem 1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .mock-patch-title { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; flex: 1; }
    .mock-approve { background: rgba(74,222,128,.15); border: 1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.3); color: var(--green); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 5px; cursor: default; }
    .mock-reject  { background: rgba(239,68,68,.1);  border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.2);  color: var(--red);   font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 5px; cursor: default; }
    .mock-diff { font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 0.8rem 1rem; line-height: 1.7; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); }
    .diff-add { color: #86efac; }
    .diff-rem { color: #fca5a5; }
    .diff-ctx { color: var(--faint); }

    /* eval vault mockup */
    .mock-eval-card { background: var(--bg2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.8rem; }
    .mock-eval-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
    .eval-name { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; flex: 1; }
    .auto-promo { font-size: 0.65rem; padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 700; }
    .auto-promo.yes { background: rgba(74,222,128,.15); color: var(--green); border: 1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.25); }
    .auto-promo.no  { background: rgba(239,68,68,.1);  color: var(--red);   border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.2); }
    .score-row { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; font-size: 0.8rem; }
    .score-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.1rem; }
    .score-val { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; }
    .score-lbl { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.7rem; }
    .score-before { color: var(--orange); }
    .score-after  { color: var(--green); }
    .score-arrow  { color: var(--teal); font-size: 1.2rem; align-self: center; }
    .eval-code {
      margin-top: 0.8rem; background: rgba(0,0,0,.3); border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 0.7rem; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: var(--muted); border: 1px solid var(--border); max-height: 100px; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .eval-code .kw { color: #c084fc; }
    .eval-code .fn { color: #7dd3fc; }
    .eval-code .str { color: #86efac; }
    .eval-code .cm { color: var(--faint); font-style: italic; }

    /* ── SETUP ── */
    #setup { background: var(--bg); }
    .setup-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; width: fit-content; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
    .setup-tab {
      padding: 0.6rem 1.4rem; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;
      background: transparent; color: var(--muted); border: none; transition: all .15s;

<section id="pipeline">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-label">⚙ How It Works</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Five stages, fully automated</h2>
    <p class="section-sub">Each stage runs asynchronously with its own DB session. A crash in one stage doesn't cascade to the others.</p>

    <div class="pipeline-grid">
      <div class="pipeline-card">
        <div class="pipeline-num">01</div>
        <h3>Classify</h3>
        <p>A Groq LLM (llama-3.3-70b-versatile) receives a truncated excerpt of the failing trace - inputs, outputs, error, and child_run names - and returns structured JSON: failure type, severity, title, description, root cause, and trace evidence quotes.</p>
        <div class="tag-row">
          <span class="tag">groq</span>
          <span class="tag">llama-3.3-70b</span>
          <span class="tag">JSON output</span>
          <span class="tag sky">12k TPM safe</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="pipeline-card">
        <div class="pipeline-num">02</div>
        <h3>Patch Bot</h3>
        <p>A LangGraph state machine runs three nodes: <strong>fetch_code</strong> extracts real file paths from stack traces and pulls them from your GitHub repo; <strong>generate_fix</strong> produces a minimal targeted patch; <strong>open_pr</strong> creates a branch, commits, and opens a PR with explanation.</p>
        <div class="tag-row">
          <span class="tag purple">LangGraph</span>
          <span class="tag">PyGitHub</span>
          <span class="tag">real code</span>
          <span class="tag sky">auto PR</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="pipeline-card">
        <div class="pipeline-num">03</div>
        <h3>Eval Writer</h3>
        <p>Groq synthesizes a LangSmith evaluator function - Python code you can add directly to your test suite. It includes a representative test input derived from the original failing trace and an expected output that the patched agent should produce.</p>
        <div class="tag-row">
          <span class="tag">groq</span>
          <span class="tag">LangSmith eval</span>
          <span class="tag sky">Python codegen</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="pipeline-card">
        <div class="pipeline-num">04</div>
        <h3>Shadow Runner</h3>
        <p>Groq-as-judge scores the original failing output and the patched expected output on a 0.0–1.0 quality scale. If the patched score is ≥10% better, the patch is auto-promoted. Both scores are written back to LangSmith as <code>traceguard/quality_before</code> and <code>traceguard/quality_after_patch</code> feedback.</p>
        <div class="tag-row">
          <span class="tag">A/B scoring</span>
          <span class="tag">LangSmith feedback</span>
          <span class="tag sky">auto-promote</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="pipeline-card">
        <div class="pipeline-num">05</div>
        <h3>Dashboard Review</h3>
        <p>The React dashboard shows every failure card with its classification, root cause, linked PR URL, diff, and shadow scores. <strong>Approve</strong> squash-merges the PR on GitHub and marks the failure resolved. <strong>Reject</strong> closes the PR with a comment. All state updates are pushed live over WebSocket.</p>
        <div class="tag-row">
          <span class="tag">React 19</span>
          <span class="tag">WebSocket</span>
          <span class="tag sky">human-in-loop</span>
          <span class="tag purple">squash merge</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="pipeline-card">
        <div class="pipeline-num">+</div>
        <h3>Crash Recovery</h3>
        <p>On startup, TraceGuard scans for failures stuck in <code>classified</code> state (e.g. from a previous container crash) and re-queues them through the patch pipeline with a staggered 10-second delay between each to stay within Groq rate limits.</p>
        <div class="tag-row">
          <span class="tag">auto-resume</span>
          <span class="tag">rate-limit safe</span>
          <span class="tag sky">startup recovery</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    let current = '';
    sections.forEach(s => {
      if (window.scrollY >= s.offsetTop - 100) current = s.id;

    });
